n: Loiano 24 Inch Freestanding Electric Range in Black
desc: The Forno Loiano 24 Inch Electric Range in Black is a compact, high-performance option for small kitchens or apartments. It features a powerful 6,000 watt cooktop, built-in air fryer basket, and both bake and single broiler elements for versatile cooking.
hl: Compact 24 Inch Electric Range: Ideal for small kitchens, apartments, condos, or secondary cooking spaces. Space-saving without compromising function.
Built-In Air Fryer Basket: Enjoy crispy, healthier meals without the need for a countertop air fryer - perfect for quick, oil-free cooking.
2.30 Cu. Ft. Oven Capacity: A spacious oven for a 24 inch range, offering enough room to cook full meals or bake in batches.
Storage Drawer Included: Keep your kitchen organized with a bottom drawer for baking sheets, pans, or accessories.
Energy-Efficient Cooking Appliance: Designed to provide high performance without excessive power consumption.
24 inch electric range with compact design
